name: Agent Skills
description: Manage the skills of the open project for every agent Orca runs: search skills.sh, add from a repo or a local folder, remove, see which agent reads which skill.

cover.alt: The Skills panel listing the project's skills with the agents that read each one, beside a skills.sh search result.

screenshots.alt: The Skills panel in Orca's light theme: four skills, each with its source and agent icons, two with a warning.
screenshots.caption: Every agent at a glance

screenshots.alt: A skill's details in the dark theme: its description, and two diverging versions, each with the agents that read it and a Keep this one button.
screenshots.caption: Keep the version you want

screenshots.alt: The same skill details in the light theme: its description, and diverging versions with Keep this one.
screenshots.caption: Keep the version you want
